title: Blue Ceramic Tile
description: A glossy, deep blue ceramic wall tile designed to bring a clean and vibrant finish to interior spaces. Its reflective surface enhances lighting and adds a modern, polished look, making it ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and feature walls.

title: White Marble Tile
description: A premium white marble flooring tile with natural veining that delivers a luxury hotel-style finish. It offers timeless elegance and durability, making it perfect for high-end living rooms, hallways, and commercial interiors.

title: Grey Stone Tile
description: A natural grey stone floor tile that brings an earthy, grounded aesthetic to any space. Its textured surface and subtle tonal variations make it ideal for modern rustic homes, patios, and high-traffic areas.

title: Wood Look Tile
description: A ceramic tile designed with a realistic wood grain texture, offering the warmth of timber with the durability of tile. Perfect for areas where natural wood is impractical, such as kitchens, bathrooms, and busy living spaces.

title: Black Matte Tile
description: A sleek black matte porcelain tile that delivers a bold, minimalist aesthetic. Its non-reflective finish creates a modern architectural feel, perfect for contemporary bathrooms, kitchens, and accent walls.

title: Mosaic Glass Tile
description: A colorful glass mosaic tile designed to create artistic and vibrant wall patterns. Its reflective glass pieces catch light beautifully, making it ideal for feature walls, bathrooms, and decorative splashbacks.

title: Beige Ceramic Tile
description: A soft beige ceramic wall tile offering a warm and neutral aesthetic suitable for any interior style. Its smooth finish and calming tone make it perfect for creating bright, spacious-looking rooms.

title: Patterned Floor Tile
description: A decorative patterned floor tile featuring intricate designs that add character and personality to interiors. Ideal for statement floors in kitchens, hallways, and boutique-style spaces.

title: Green Subway Tile
description: A glossy green subway-style ceramic tile perfect for kitchen backsplashes and bathroom walls. Its elongated shape and vibrant tone add freshness and modern charm to interior spaces.

title: Luxury Gold Accent Tile
description: A decorative gold accent tile designed to bring luxury and sophistication into interior spaces. Its reflective metallic finish makes it perfect for feature walls, high-end bathrooms, and premium commercial interiors.

title: Outdoor Slate Tile
description: A durable slate patio tile built for outdoor environments. It offers strong weather resistance and a natural textured finish, making it ideal for gardens, patios, and exterior walkways.

title: Hexagon Cement Tile
description: A modern hexagon-shaped cement tile designed for stylish geometric flooring patterns. Its unique shape adds visual interest and is commonly used in contemporary kitchens, bathrooms, and feature floors.

title: Terrazzo Tile
description: A vibrant terrazzo tile featuring a composite mix of stone chips for a stylish speckled appearance. It is highly durable and works well in modern residential and commercial flooring applications.

title: Brick Wall Tile
description: A rustic clay brick-style wall tile that recreates the look of exposed brickwork. It adds warmth and character, making it ideal for industrial, loft-style, and traditional interior designs.

title: Red Gloss Tile
description: A bold red glossy ceramic tile designed to create striking visual impact in interior spaces. Its high-shine finish enhances lighting and makes it suitable for feature walls and creative design projects.

title: Modern Bathroom Tile
description: A premium porcelain bathroom tile designed for modern interiors, offering a clean, elegant finish suitable for both floors and walls. Its durable surface resists moisture, making it ideal for bathrooms and wet areas.
